heroHeadline: Volcanic Eruption Strands 270,000 as Indonesia Reels From a Deadly Quake, Wildfire Crisis and Graft Protests
heroSubtitle: Mount Anak Krakatau's eruption shut eight airports including Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta in early September, capping a brutal month after a magnitude-7.7 earthquake killed 53+ on Flores and wildfire haze exposed 5M+ people across Borneo and Sumatra. Thousands marched on parliament demanding a corruption crackdown, winning a pledge to pass the long-stalled Asset Forfeiture Bill, while Prabowo held a fifth summit with Putin in Vladivostok and joined 13 nations in the Super Garuda Shield military exercise.
footerNote: Data sourced from Sekretariat Negara RI, BPS Statistics Indonesia, BNPB, Komnas HAM, World Bank, Project Multatuli, Human Rights Monitor, and verified academic historical sources.
